name: work-audit
description: Audit every piece of outstanding work — branches, worktrees, PRs, tracker tickets, stale planning artifacts and parallel sessions — verifying each claimed status against what is actually on the trunk, then produce an HTML report and a phased close-down plan. Read-only, and it confirms first when it fires on inference rather than a direct request. Includes an opt-in cleanup workflow that preserves before it deletes.
